description: Hardened local MCP server for explicitly selected Thunderbird accounts and address books

functions.name: start
functions.description: Start the authenticated MCP HTTP server on loopback

functions.name: getServerInfo
functions.description: Get current server status, port, and build information

functions.name: getAccountAccessConfig
functions.description: Get the explicit account allow-list configuration

parameters.name: allowedAccountIds
parameters.description: Account IDs to allow. Empty array blocks all accounts.

functions.name: getAddressBookAccessConfig
functions.description: Get the explicit address-book allow-list configuration

parameters.name: allowedAddressBookIds
parameters.description: Address-book IDs to allow. Empty array blocks all address books.

functions.name: getDirectSendConfig
functions.description: Get local direct-send policy and current quota status

functions.name: setDirectSendConfig
functions.description: Replace the local direct-send policy. Enabling requires the exact confirmation phrase.
